result.reason: The redline appropriately limits exclusivity to Deerskin Products and twelve months, but it does not provide the required automatic fallaway upon any failure to meet service levels or delivery dates. Most failures trigger termination only if they are material and remain uncured for thirty days after notice, and the generic reference to Sections 1 and 5 is both broader and less precise than a direct service-level/delivery-date trigger. The launch-date trigger is also awkward because the Effective Date—and thus the exclusivity period—does not begin until the Site is fully operational. Unrelated term and termination provisions remain unchanged, but the broader material-obligation trigger changes more than necessary.
